newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-INJURED GRAF OUT FOR TWO WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-INJURED GRAF OUT FOR TWO WEEKS.

text.p: Steffi Graf will be out of action for two weeks because of the knee injury which forced her to withdraw from the Pan Pacific final in Tokyo at the weekend.

The world number one consulted a German doctor about the problem with her left knee on Tuesday. The injury was not as serious as feared and the German hoped to be fit to play in a WTA event in Hanover starting on February 17.
